messages:
Ana: Quick sync — GCP asked for a private-offer SKU lock for 12 months with a 30% committed discount. Thoughts on margin & renewal signal?
Mike: 30% is pretty steep for that SKU unless we get a firm commit band and upsell runway. What's the expected ARR?
Ana: They penciled $360k ARR (so $300k after discount). They want the SKU mapped to a marketplace listing so buyers can accept the PO.
Divya: If the ARR assumption holds, unit economics look OK but we need a renewal cliff to avoid step-down surprise. Recommend a phased stepdown: 30% year1, 20% year2 if commit maintained.
Sam: Legal flags: auto-renew on marketplace private offers needs explicit consent and clear opt-out window. Also need to approve the public-facing collateral for any co-announcement.
Mike: For seller comms, we should lock messaging: "12-month SKU lock + intro credits for new SI engagements". Asking partners to co-sell only after the first 60 days.
Ana: Proposed offer snippet for GCP PO:
```
SKU: RDF-DEDC-1
Commit: $300,000/year
Discount: 30% off list for 12 months
Add-on: $25k onboarding credit for SI partners (one-time)
Renewal: Optional 12-month renewal; stepdown to 20% if renewed within 30 days of term end
```
Divya: Add a clause that usage above commit is billed at list minus 10% so we don't give unlimited upside at full discount.
Sam: Also include an audit right and a 60-day notification for price changes. For co-announcement: require legal review 7 business days prior.
gcp-bizdev-bot: New GCP private offer draft uploaded: https://drive.company/gcp-pov/sku-lock-draft-v1 (permissions: partners@gcp)
Mike: Thanks — I'll prep seller-facing FAQ: mapping between marketplace SKU and our internal reserved capacity SKU + how credits apply. Need input from eng on activation lead time.
Ana: Eng-infra says activation for reserved capacity SKUs is ~48-72 hours once PO accepted. We'll capture that in the FAQ.
Divya: Ops ask: track committed spend per-customer in billing dashboard so renewals trigger alerts 90/45/14 days out. I'll create a ticket.
Sam: One more: escalate play if customer consumption <50% of commit at month 6 — enable health outreach + flexible re-route offers to avoid churn.
Mike: Sounds good. Action items: 1) Mike draft seller FAQ (due EOD Wed), 2) Divya create billing alert ticket, 3) Sam draft legal addendum for private offers, 4) Ana coordinate co-announcement timeline with GCP (targeting first-half next quarter).
Ana: I'll ping GCP for alignment and circle back here with their marketing windows. :thumbsup:
Mike: +1
Divya: +1
Sam: +1
